title: scariola chondrilliflora
intro: Scariola chondrilliflora, commonly known as Chondrilla, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is known for its edible flowers, leaves, and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Chondrilla include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and improving overall health. The bioactive constituents of Chondrilla include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
